clue.text: Maker of furniture stripper?

definitions.meaning: Thomas ... was the celebrated 18th-century English cabinetmaker
a famous troupe of male strip-show dancers; the question mark flags the jokey sense

explanation.surface: A riddle asking who makes furniture, or perhaps who strips old furniture of its varnish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Stripper' looks like someone removing paint from furniture, which fits the first half; it is in fact a member of the male dance troupe.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses are proper names: the Georgian cabinetmaker, and the dancing troupe named after him.

clue.text: Keen to run over and cause unnecessary alarm

parts.note: to keen is to wail or lament, so to cry

indicators.note: over signals that the word for running is turned back to front

parts.note: to run, as water does, is to flow

explanation.surface: Someone eager to rush over and set off a needless panic.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Keen' reads as an eager adjective, but here it is the verb meaning to wail.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom comes from Aesop's shepherd boy who raised false alarms about a predator until nobody believed him.

clue.text: Combined pub drinking round with eating, initially

indicators.note: drinking means the pub takes in, or swallows, the round letter

parts.note: an inn is a pub
a round shape is the letter O

indicators.note: initially says only the opening letter of eating is used

explanation.surface: A pub that serves rounds of drinks alongside food.
explanation.definitionFit: Two things rolled into a single item, as in a printer and scanner together, are joined or merged.

clue.text: Prime minister's first night finished early

indicators.note: finished early means the word stops one letter short of its end

parts.note: a show's first night is its premiere

explanation.surface: A political leader's opening night at the theatre was cut short.
explanation.definitionFit: The head of a government, especially in Britain or a Canadian province, is also called by this title, from French for first.

clue.text: Written using symbols — indefinite number to date misinterpreted?

parts.note: N stands for an unspecified number in mathematics

indicators.note: misinterpreted says the letters of to date are read in a wrong, rearranged order

explanation.surface: Something recorded in symbols, with an unknown quantity so far read wrongly.
explanation.definitionFit: Music or mathematics set down in a formal system of signs is described with this participle.

clue.text: A lake in European country, one of the largest countries

indicators.note: in says the A and lake letters are placed inside the European country

parts.note: Austria is a country in central Europe
L is the standard abbreviation for lake on maps

explanation.surface: A lake within a European nation, as if setting up a geography quiz.
explanation.walkthrough: Wordplay and definition both name countries; the trick is that the small one sits around letters to make the vast one.
explanation.definitionFit: The continental nation is the sixth largest in the world by area.

clue.text: Steering clear of five in Berkshire town right from the start

indicators.note: from the start says the right letter is taken off the front of the word
in says the five letter goes inside the town's name

parts.note: Reading is a large town in Berkshire, a county west of London
V is the Roman numeral for five

explanation.surface: Somebody dodging a group of five in an English town, from the very beginning.
explanation.walkthrough: 'from the start' looks like a phrase meaning 'from the outset', but it says R is removed from the front of REVADING.
explanation.definitionFit: Dodging or keeping away from something is a straightforward synonym, both present participles.

clue.text: PM in front of bar, focal point for dancers

indicators.note: in front of puts the prime minister's name before the bar

parts.note: Theresa May was a British Prime Minister
a pole is a long bar

explanation.surface: A Prime Minister stands before a bar, a place where people gather to dance.
explanation.walkthrough: PM is Prime Minister; Theresa May led the UK government 2016-19.
explanation.definitionFit: Folk dancers weave ribbons around this decorated post on May Day, so it is the centre of their dance.

clue.text: Tiny policeman in comic is swimming across river

indicators.note: in says the policeman sits inside the rest
swimming across suggests the letters of comic is moving about and taking in the river letter as they are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written
a cop is a policeman

explanation.surface: A small policeman in a comic strip swims across a river.
explanation.walkthrough: 'swimming across' rearranges COMIC IS with R to MICROSIC; 'in' then puts COP inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Something so small it can only be seen under magnification is minute in the extreme.

clue.text: A short study released about American modeller

indicators.note: about says the shuffled letters go around the American abbreviation
released suggests the letters are set free and shuffled into a new order

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: short means the last letter of study is lopped off

parts.note: to study is to swot or read, but here study is simply the word itself

explanation.surface: A brief piece of research about an American sculptor is published.
explanation.walkthrough: 'released' looks like 'published', but it signals the shuffle that turns A STUD into TSAUD.
explanation.definitionFit: Marie Tussaud sculpted wax figures and founded the famous London museum of lifelike models.

clue.text: With poverty around, have tofu with 50% off — that's practical

indicators.note: around says the scarcity word wraps around the other letters

parts.note: a dearth is a lack or poverty of something
to have something is to own it

indicators.note: with 50% off says only the first half of tofu is kept

explanation.surface: Someone short of money buying half-price tofu, which is a sensible move.
explanation.definitionFit: A sensible, realistic person is often called this, an idiom for being grounded rather than fanciful.

clue.text: Courtyard nearby

definitions.meaning: an enclosed yard or precinct, especially around a cathedral, is called by this name

explanation.definitionFit: One word serves both as a noun for an enclosed precinct and as an adjective for proximity.

clue.text: Meeting with candidate at work, perhaps — brief session to contend with

definitions.text: Meeting with candidate at work, perhaps

indicators.note: brief says the session phrase is cut short by its last letter

parts.note: being in session is being in term, the phrase run together
to vie is to contend or compete

explanation.surface: A job candidate faces a short session that must be contended with.
explanation.walkthrough: 'session' gives IN TERM (a court or school in session is in term), and 'brief' clips its last letter.
explanation.definitionFit: A formal conversation in which an employer questions a job applicant is the usual sense, though work is only one setting.

clue.text: Policeman in charge intercepting tender

indicators.note: intercepting says the in-charge letters cut into the middle of the tender word

parts.note: to tender is to offer

explanation.surface: A police chief stops someone handing over a bid.
explanation.definitionFit: A constable or other member of a police force is addressed as this rank-neutral title.

clue.text: Part of plant or insect or bird

parts.note: a corm is the swollen underground stem base of a plant such as a crocus
an ant is an insect

explanation.surface: A quiz question offering a choice: part of a plant, or an insect, or a bird.
explanation.definitionFit: This dark fish-eating seabird is a specific example of the general class.

clue.text: Transport from French match?

parts.note: de is the French word for from
a match is a light, as in asking for a light

explanation.surface: A question about shipping something from a French football match.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Transport' looks like moving goods, but it is the verb for sending someone into raptures.
explanation.definitionFit: To transport someone emotionally is to enrapture or thrill them, the same sense as the verb in the answer.

clue.text: Cooking career involves little time for one in an associated profession?

indicators.note: involves says the rearranged letters wrap around the time letter
cooking suggests the letters of career are worked up and rearranged

parts.note: taken as written
T is the short form of time

explanation.surface: A career in cooking leaves little spare time.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cooking' reads as the profession, but it rearranges CAREER to CAERER; the question mark admits the definition leans on that cooking surface.
explanation.definitionFit: A food-supplier for events works in a line close to cookery, hence the associated trade.

clue.text: Wrong to keep working over in Canadian city

indicators.note: to keep says the wrong word holds the working letters within it

parts.note: a tort is a civil wrong in law
a machine that is working is on
O is the cricket scoring abbreviation for an over

explanation.surface: It is a mistake to carry on working overtime in a Canadian city.
explanation.definitionFit: The capital of Ontario is Canada's largest city, a straightforward example.

clue.text: Story about entertaining Gulf state clubs

indicators.note: entertaining means holding as a guest, so the about word holds the rest inside

parts.note: re means about or concerning
Oman is a state on the Arabian Gulf
C is the abbreviation for clubs in card games

explanation.surface: A tale of hosting a Gulf nation's sports clubs.
explanation.definitionFit: A love story or a medieval tale of chivalric adventure is a kind of narrative.

clue.text: Available in pharmacy, an ideal poison

indicators.note: Available in says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A sinister boast that a chemist's shop is the perfect place to buy a toxin.
explanation.definitionFit: This compound, smelling faintly of almonds, is a notoriously fast-acting toxin.

clue.text: Line breaks making better game

indicators.note: breaks says the line letter splits open the other word

parts.note: curing a patient is making them better

explanation.surface: A broken line makes a game improve.
explanation.definitionFit: Players slide granite stones over ice in this winter sport, one example of a game.

clue.text: Knight goes on hunting goddess to support single state

indicators.note: in a down answer the supporting piece sits below, so the single letter has the rest built on top of it

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one, a single

indicators.note: goes on says the knight letter is followed by the goddess

parts.note: N is the chess notation for a knight
Diana was the Roman goddess of the hunt

explanation.surface: A knight joins the huntress goddess to help a lone American state.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue, 'to support' puts the supporting piece at the bottom; here the rest sits under I, so the knight-and-goddess part is what I supports.
explanation.definitionFit: This Midwestern US member of the union is one example of a state.

clue.text: Agent recalled earlier entertainer

indicators.note: recalled, as in called back, says the agent word is read in reverse

parts.note: a rep, short for representative, is a sales agent
former means earlier or previous

explanation.surface: A talent agent remembers an entertainer from the past.
explanation.definitionFit: A singer, actor or other person who puts on a show is a general synonym.

clue.text: A German article about large tree

indicators.note: about says the A and article letters go around the large letter

parts.note: der is the masculine form of the in German
L is the clothing size abbreviation for large

explanation.surface: A German newspaper piece about a large tree.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' looks like 'concerning', but it wraps A DER round L.
explanation.definitionFit: This damp-loving member of the birch family is one example of a tree.

clue.text: Tree we see while followed by swan

indicators.note: followed by says the while word comes first, then the swan

parts.note: as can mean while, as in 'as I was walking'
a pen is a female swan

explanation.surface: A riverside scene: a tree we see as a swan glides past.
explanation.definitionFit: This poplar with trembling leaves is one example of a tree.

clue.text: Hold crushed tin can, nothing inside

indicators.note: inside says the nothing letter goes within the jumbled letters
crushed suggests the letters of tin can are squashed into a new shape

parts.note: taken as written
O, the figure zero, means nothing

explanation.surface: Someone holding a squashed tin can with nothing in it.
explanation.definitionFit: To have something within, as a box does its contents, is to hold it.

clue.text: Charge mischievous child brought before a head

indicators.note: brought before says the child word comes first in the answer

parts.note: an imp is a mischievous child
a head, as in a price per person, means each

explanation.surface: A naughty child is charged and hauled before a head teacher.
explanation.walkthrough: 'a head' looks like the head teacher, but it means per person, so EACH.
explanation.definitionFit: To formally accuse an official of misconduct is to bring a charge against them.

clue.text: Scheduled for discussion with regard to Melbourne newspaper and changes

parts.note: on can mean about or with regard to, as in a talk on art
The Age is a daily newspaper published in Melbourne, Australia

indicators.note: changes says the letters of and are rearranged

explanation.surface: An Australian newspaper's revisions are to be talked over at a meeting.
explanation.definitionFit: Items listed for a meeting's business are down to be discussed, the idiom's plain meaning.
